newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian who shot Man Utd fans gets four years jail.
newsitem.headline: Austrian who shot Man Utd fans gets four years jail.

text.p: A Vienna court sentenced an Austrian man to four years in jail for shooting and seriously wounding two Manchester United soccer fans last December after a row in a bar, court officials said on Monday.
Alfred Gockner, 34, was charged with grievous bodily harm after he shot Stephen Day in the stomach, and Day's friend Christopher MacKenner in the right leg.
Gockner's companion Willibald Kettinger, 44, was found guilty of acting as an accomplice and received a nine-month suspended sentence.
Gockner fired on a group of Manchester United fans from a Mercedes car after a dispute in a sauna-bar in Vienna's red light district.
Day, who had come to Austria with three friends for a football match between Manchester United and Rapid Vienna, underwent a three-hour abdominal operation following the attack.
Gockner said he had not meant to hurt the men. He had just wanted to scare them.
